continent.name: Aethermere
continent.description: The known continent. The Lumencia Empire dominates its central and western regions; the Holy Kingdom of Dominus lies to the south; the Abyss Zone occupies the far east.

polities.name: Lumencia Empire
polities.description: A medieval fantasy empire with a powerful aristocracy and advanced martial and magical institutions. Education is officially open to nobles and commoners, but wealth, lineage and political networks create substantial real-world inequality.

polities.name: Holy Kingdom of Dominus
polities.description: A neighboring theocratic state that worships Lily and trains divine healers, holy warriors and inquisitors. It sends selected representatives and students to Lumencia Academy.

polities.name: Abyss Zone
polities.description: A dangerous region in the far east associated with demonic spawning, Miasma and the Demon God Cult's headquarters.

setting_principles: The official ideal of equal opportunity conflicts with entrenched noble privilege.
Academy politics mirror political and social conflicts in the wider empire.
No single plot outcome should be assumed before the player encounters it.
Power differences are consequential, especially in direct combat.
